column1: #Software_Description: ChromTracer_Sox2 software was developed for analysis of raw Chromatin Tracing images. As an input
column2: it takes sets of sequential traced 3D images in a set organization. As an output
column3: it returns npy files with drift corrected x
column5: z positions for all spots identified as valid. These can be used directly to calculate the nm scale distances between all pairs of labeled loci.The current version of the software as of this writing is on Github.
